Acts.title: Which law applies to your marriage?
Acts.lede: Each Act sets its own eligibility, notice period, objection window, and required documents. Choose the one that matches your ceremony.

HMA_1955.label: The Hindu Marriage Act, 1955
HMA_1955.summary: For a marriage already solemnised under Hindu rites. Apply after the ceremony. Objections may be filed for 7 days from the date the application is received; registration is completed within 6 calendar months.

SMA_13.label: The Special Marriage Act, 1954 — Section 13
SMA_13.summary: For a marriage to be solemnised before the Marriage Officer. A notice of intended marriage is published for 30 days; the marriage is then solemnised and registered within 3 months of the notice period ending.

SMA_16.label: The Special Marriage Act, 1954 — Section 16
SMA_16.summary: For registering a marriage already solemnised in another form. The application may be made no earlier than 30 days after the marriage. Objections may be filed for 30 days; registration is completed within 6 calendar months.

ICMA_1872.label: The Indian Christian Marriage Act, 1872
ICMA_1872.summary: For Christian marriages solemnised by a licensed minister or Marriage Registrar. Both parties must be 21 or older; where a party is between 18 and 21, guardian consent is required.

PMDA_1936.label: The Parsi Marriage and Divorce Act, 1936
PMDA_1936.summary: For Parsi marriages solemnised by a priest in the presence of two Parsi witnesses. The certificate signed by the priest is registered with the Registrar.

Objections.title: File an objection.
Objections.lede: Any person may object to a marriage being registered while its notice period is open. Your objection goes to the Marriage Officer handling the application.
Objections.groundsPlaceholder: Set out the legal ground on which you object to this marriage being registered.
Objections.warning: Objections are examined by the Marriage Officer. Filing a false objection is an offence.

guidance.DRAFT: You have not submitted this application yet. Continue where you left off.
guidance.PAYMENT_PENDING: Complete the fee payment to submit your application.
guidance.SUBMITTED: We have received your application. A Marriage Officer will be assigned shortly.
guidance.UNDER_SCRUTINY: The Marriage Officer is checking your documents. No action is needed from you.
guidance.AWAITING_APPLICANT_FIX: The office has asked for a correction. Open the application to see what is needed.
guidance.NOTICE_PUBLISHED: Your notice is published. The objection period is running.
guidance.OBJECTION_UNDER_ENQUIRY: An objection has been filed and is being examined by the office.
guidance.AWAITING_REGISTRATION: The objection period has closed. Your registration appointment will be confirmed.
guidance.REGISTERED: Your marriage is registered. The certificate will be issued shortly.
guidance.CERTIFICATE_ISSUED: Your certificate has been issued. You may download a certified copy.
guidance.CORRECTION_PENDING: A correction to your certificate is being processed.
guidance.CANCELLED: This application was cancelled. See the note from the office for the reason.
guidance.LAPSED: This application lapsed because the registration deadline passed.
